scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix functions install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm --prefix functions test && npm --prefix web test && npm --prefix web run test:integration
scripts.lint: npm --prefix functions run lint && npm --prefix web run lint
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json && npm --prefix functions run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
